pm_takeaway: Uber delivered an exceptionally clean, institutional-grade print for Q3 2026. Gross Bookings surged 20% YoY to $59.82B, marking five straight quarters of 20%+ growth. Total revenue reached $14,766M (+10% YoY, beating consensus of $14,673.58M). While Non-GAAP EPS of $0.88 (+35% YoY) slightly lagged consensus ($0.90) due to strategic investments in delivery supply, operating cash flow climbed to $2,639M and reported FCF reached $2,535M, delivering a True Forensic FCF of $1,944M net of $591M SBC. Management raised Q4 Gross Bookings guidance to $63.25B-$65.25B and Non-GAAP EPS to $0.95-$0.99, while accelerating autonomous fleet targets to 700 vehicles in 2026 and >2,000 in 2027. Trading flat at $69.84, Uber represents an elite large-cap compounder trading at just ~15.8x forward earnings.
